messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] problem regarding P value
parts:
Only thing that might be related to what you are seeing is that methRead() has now an additional argument "min.cov", which defaults to 10. That means any CpG that has lower than 10 reads is discarded. 
It doesn't make sense to do tests on CpGs with low read counts, and you can get a p-value of 1, please run the following code in R and see the p-value\

fisher.test(matrix(c(1,1,1,1),ncol=2))
